name: Buy Me a Coffee
description: Adds a "Buy Me a Coffee" donation button/widget as a block.
project_description:
The Buy Me a Coffee module for Drupal allows users to easily integrate the Buy Me a Coffee donation platform into their websites, enabling visitors to support content creators by making small donations. This module simplifies the process of adding donation functionality to Drupal sites, empowering users to monetize their content and engage with their audience in a meaningful way.

 Supporting this Module 
 If you found the module helpful, you can test it and treat the author to a cup of coffee .

 Features 
 The Buy Me a Coffee module for Drupal provides functionality to integrate a "Buy Me a Coffee" button or widget into a Drupal website:

 1. Basic Functionality: 

 - The basic functionality of the Buy Me a Coffee module is to allow content creators, bloggers, or website owners to add a donation button or widget to their Drupal website. This button typically links to the content creator's Buy Me a Coffee page where visitors can support them by making a donation.

 2. Unique Features: 

 - The main unique feature of enabling the Buy Me a Coffee module is the ability to easily integrate a donation option into a Drupal website without the need for custom coding.

 - The module may provide customization options such as button styles, text, and placement to fit the website's design and branding.

 3. Use Cases: 

 - Content Creators: Bloggers, podcasters, YouTubers, or any other content creators who rely on donations or tips to support their work can use this module to solicit donations from their audience.

 - Non-profit Organizations: Non-profit organizations or charitable causes can use the Buy Me a Coffee module to collect donations directly through their Drupal website.

 - Independent Artists: Musicians, artists, or writers can leverage this module to receive support from fans and followers who appreciate their work.

 4. When and Why to Use: 

 - Use the Buy Me a Coffee module when you want to offer your audience a simple and convenient way to support your work financially.

 - It can be used when you want to supplement your income as a content creator or artist by receiving small donations from your audience.

 - This module is suitable for websites that rely on community support and want to provide an easy avenue for visitors to contribute financially.

 In summary, the Buy Me a Coffee module adds a straightforward donation functionality to Drupal websites, enabling content creators, artists, and organizations to receive financial support from their audience or supporters. It offers a seamless way for visitors to contribute financially, thereby helping website owners sustain their creative or philanthropic endeavors.
